query: Geological Bedrock Corridor Southview Agricultural Commons July 4–6 2024 holiday observance road occupancy measured impact versus baseline

evidence.claim: Holiday-related reductions in regional long-distance transit demand cause lower Geological Bedrock Corridor occupancy during the active prediction window.
evidence.exact_quote: As the volume of long-distance trips fluctuates downward—most notably during concentrated holiday observance periods—the interaction with local entry and exit points on the Geological Bedrock Corridor diminishes proportionally. Within the active prediction window (t0 to t1), the aggregate reduction in transit demand leads to a corresponding drop in occupancy on the Geological Bedrock Corridor.

impacts.rationale: The document explicitly places a holiday-driven reduction within the prediction window, contradicting unchanged local-level persistence. It gives no measured magnitude or exact observance boundaries, so no quantitative adjustment is justified.
